requirement: QA only judges the held session and the accepted prompt; watchdog and lease stop stale rounds

oracle.invariant: A non-matching turn or a missing receipt does not start QA. The first prompt also times out; a worker whose lease expired does not overwrite or send a repair. Two failed repairs leave Needs review, never Outreach.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: qaOutcome: all pass completes; a failure repairs twice, then needs a person — never completed
repairPrompt: scope-locked, coordinates per failed check, and css-intact restores instead of repairing
placedPaths and briefOf: what Tracy placed is never demo; booking may leave only for verified links
briefOf: Google reviews are not facts — their words never reach the judge, the rest of the brief does
pagePlanMissing: a page the build kept that the site does not reach fails PAGE_PLAN_MISSING; soft shapes; none without a plan
no round while the hand-off chat has no closed turn since the hand-off, or one is still open
passing round: qa passed, hand-off completed, the host read the baseline pages against the baseline
failing round: the repair list goes into the hand-off chat, qa retry, and the next closed turn is judged
the nav changed after a repair: the next round reads the new pages, and each round keeps what it read
a build with a page plan: a kept page the site does not reach fails the round with PAGE_PLAN_MISSING; each round keeps what the host visited
a build with a page plan: the host is asked to read every kept page with a path, beside what nav finds
out of repairs: qa failed, hand-off needs-review — never completed, no third repair sent
a repair list the chat refuses, and a host that never answers, leave the demo to a person
a leased build is not taken twice: two runners at once judge it once
repairPrompt: a phone overflow is never answered with overflow on html/body, and a clipped page says to undo it
a repair list the agent never started on is sent once more, then needs a person — never a silent wait
a look-kept failure sends the agent the token and the file, and the rule it broke
the first hand-off prompt has the same watchdog as repairs; an unrelated turn cannot keep it waiting
an expired QA worker cannot overwrite the next replica or send a repair after its host returns
only the held session and accepted prompt id can trigger QA; neither a nearby turn nor a missing receipt qualifies
